channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Zema, Renan e Caiado chamam de 'eleitoreiro' reajuste do Bolsa Família
item.description: Presidential candidates Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Renan Santos (Missão), and Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized the federal government's announced Bolsa Família readjustment, labeling the measure as electioneering.

item.title: Dólar fecha o dia em R$ 5,13 após decisões do Fed e do BC
item.description: The dollar closed at R$5.13 amid mixed pressure from the Fed and Copom, while the government announced an expansion of Bolsa Família. The Ibovespa rose 0.30% driven by Vale, despite volatility from the government announcement.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula participa de caminhada em Montes Claros
item.description: President Lula takes part in a walk in Montes Claros (MG) alongside Patrus Ananias, the PT candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, closing his schedule in the city. The event includes allies and candidates supported by the PT ticket in the state.

item.title: Ibovespa tem alta de 0,24% em meio a novas pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The Ibovespa rose 0.24% to 185,900 points, driven by US and Brazilian interest rate decisions and the ongoing election race. Polls suggest Flávio Bolsonaro is gaining ground against Lula, according to a Veedha Investments analyst. The dollar fell to R$5.13 while banks showed mixed performance in the market.

item.title: Deputado Zé Trovão (PL), aliado de Flávio Bolsonaro, vai ao TSE contra aumento do Bolsa Família
item.description: Deputy Zé Trovão (PL-SC), an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, asked the TSE to suspend a 15% Bolsa Família increase and fine Lula, arguing that it could benefit Lula's reelection campaign. The AGU defended the adjustment as legal and said it falls within the exceptions in Brazil's electoral legislation.

item.title: Por que esta eleição é a mais despolitizada e isso favorece a extrema direita
item.description: The article argues that the 2026 elections are the most depoliticized, with debates focused on corruption scandals rather than governance projects. This apathy favors the far-right, while the institutional left remains on the defensive, missing the opportunity to mobilize social policies that the right historically had to adopt to compete in contexts of inequality.

item.title: Publicitário ligado a Vorcaro estampa "adesivaço" de Flávio em carrão
item.description: Thiago Miranda, a publicist targeted by the Federal Police in investigations linked to Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master, posted support for Flávio Bolsonaro on a luxury car and shared the senator’s campaign jingle. Police say Miranda also intermediated Vorcaro’s contact with Flávio in a film project about Jair Bolsonaro funded with resources under investigation and worked on communications defending the bank.

item.title: Há muitas diferenças entre o aumento do Bolsa Família de Lula e o de Bolsonaro
item.description: The report highlights that the Bolsa Família increase announced by Lula during an election period resembles Bolsonaro's 2022 measure, with both driven by electoral interests. Full content is subscriber-only.

item.title: Novo pede afastamento de Moraes do caso que apura mensagens com Vorcaro
item.description: The Novo Party requested STF President Edson Fachin to remove Justice Alexandre de Moraes from the case investigating messages with banker Daniel Vorcaro. The party argues Moraes acted as both an interested party and judge in the same proceeding, constituting a legal impediment.

item.title: Mendonça estava utilizando o cargo para fazer política, diz Lula
item.description: Lula accused Minister André Mendonça of using his role as rapporteur to conduct politics, citing alleged selective leaks tied to the Banco Master case. He also attacked Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro, suggesting the country needs transparency regarding process information. Lula defended simultaneous trials for all involved in the STF to prevent bias before elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vincula Lula a Moraes e diz que vai indicar 6 ministros do STF, caso eleito
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) linked Lula to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, claimed Lula owes him his mandate, and said he could appoint up to six STF ministers if elected. He favored conservative nominees and criticized the 15% increase in Bolsa Família as electoral desperation.

item.title: Governo Lula vê relatório sobre CV e PCC como manobra segura de Trump
item.description: The Lula administration views the U.S. accusation that it failed to confront the PCC and Comando Vermelho as a low-cost electoral move by Trump, less risky than sanctions against Supreme Court ministers. Although a significant share of Brazilian public opinion supports designating the groups as terrorist organizations, the government fears that renewed U.S. interference could benefit Lula.

item.title: Lula diz que não foca em pesquisas e critica Flávio: "Ligação com o Master"
item.description: Lula expresses confidence in his reelection bid and criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro over ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro, suspected of a banking fraud scheme. He highlights the recovery of R$ 6.5 billion from INSS and states he does not focus on polls, trusting that voters will decide on election day.

item.title: Bolsa Família: Lula repete Bolsonaro em medidas na véspera da eleição
item.description: Lula announces a 15.04% increase in Bolsa Família 17 days before the 2026 first round, raising the minimum benefit from R$600 to R$691. The measure, costing an estimated R$5.8 billion in 2026, mirrors the 2022 Auxílio Brasil expansion ahead of elections. The government claims inflation adjustment and states the measure complies with budgetary rules without extraordinary credit.

item.title: Lula acusa Mendonça de usar caso Master para “fazer política”
item.description: Lula criticizes Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, accusing him of using the Banco Master case rapporteurship for political purposes. The president insists all involved must be judged and punished.

item.title: Governo Lula vê relatório sobre PCC e CV como 'muito grave' e brecha para ações militares dos Estados Unidos
item.description: Lula's government considers 'very serious' a US report accusing Brazil of failing to combat the PCC and CV factions, recently designated as terrorist organizations. Itamaraty fears the document could pave the way for US military actions, while the Ministry of Justice refutes the claims by highlighting the Anti-Gang Law and existing bilateral cooperation.

item.title: De interferência a crime organizado: o que Lula deve abordar na ONU
item.description: Lula will address the UN General Assembly and is expected to defend democracy, sovereignty and the integrity of Brazil’s electoral process without directly mentioning the United States. He will also address multilateralism, global conflicts, the environment, human rights and trade, while organized crime and the Supreme Court crisis are likely to take a back seat.

item.title: Lula endossou ato de Vieira de rejeitar exigências dos EUA sobre dissidentes, Boeing e terras raras
item.description: President Lula endorsed Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira's decision to reject a 21-point US proposal including demands for participation of political dissidents in 2026 elections and preferential access to critical minerals. The proposal was deemed unacceptable by Brazil's diplomatic corps and considered 'dead on arrival' after the minister reviewed its contents during meetings in Washington with Marco Rubio and US trade representatives.

item.title: Zé Trovão, aliado de Flávio Bolsonaro, vai ao TSE contra reajuste do Bolsa Família; Mendonça vai ser o relator
item.description: Congressman Zé Trovão, an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, filed a lawsuit at the TSE against the Bolsa Família increase announced by Lula's government. The raise from R$ 600 to R$ 691 takes effect in October, amid the electoral calendar. The government and the AGU argue the measure only offsets inflation and is outside any electoral restrictions.

item.title: Lula acusa Mendonça de "fazer política" como relator: "Está provado"
item.description: Lula accused André Mendonça of politicizing his role in the Banco Master investigation and selectively disclosing information, claims the justice denies on grounds of protecting an ongoing probe. Lula also warned that Flávio Bolsonaro will not evade scrutiny, while saying Alexandre de Moraes should face punishment if any wrongdoing is proven.

item.title: Entenda as operações contra infiltração do PCC nos ônibus de SP
item.description: Prosecutors and Civil Police launched Operation Vectura Corrupta, investigating PCC infiltration in 12 São Paulo bus companies and suspected bid-rigging. The operation executes 16 arrest warrants targeting former councilman Milton Leite (União Brasil). Investigations since 2024 uncovered a PCC-controlled fintech moving R$ 8 billion and led to the arrest of councilman Senival Moura (PT).

item.title: Flávio: reajuste no Bolsa Família é "ilegal" e "ato de desespero" de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Lula’s 15.04% Bolsa Família increase, calling it illegal and election-driven without substantiating the allegation. The benefit floor will rise from R$600 to R$691, with initial payments due on October 19, 17 days before the election.

item.title: Prefeito de Nova York, Zohran Mamdani quer se encontrar com Lula
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula is expected to meet New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani in New York at the Brazilian mission to the UN before the president's UN General Assembly speech. The meeting is expected to focus mainly on public policies, particularly housing, rather than international issues.

item.title: Mendonça é aplaudido e chamado de “herói” em voo para SP
item.description: Passengers applauded André Mendonça and called him a “hero” on a flight from Brasília to São Paulo. That same day, Gilmar Mendes again criticized him for lifting the secrecy of a Federal Police report in the Banco Master case, accusing him of improperly drawing the STF into the election campaign.

item.title: Lula defende julgamento conjunto de Moraes e Mendonça no STF
item.description: Lula called for the Supreme Court to try the probes into ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça jointly, arguing that all those involved should be assessed together. He also accused Mendonça of using his position for political purposes and noted Bolsonaro-aligned opposition to Moraes.

item.title: Mendonça será relator de ação de Zé Trovão para barrar reajuste do Bolsa Família
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça will oversee a complaint filed by federal deputy Zé Trovão (PL-SC) against President Lula. The action challenges the 15% Bolsa Família increase decreed 17 days before the 2026 election's first round, alleging potential electoral misuse of the benefit hike.

item.title: Zema chama reajuste do Bolsa Família de 'medida eleitoreira' e propõe R$ 5 mil por carteira
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) labeled the Bolsa Família adjustment as an 'electoral measure' and proposed R$5,000 per job. The minimum benefit increased from R$600 to R$691.

item.title: Nunes Marques deve retirar impedimento em votações no STF após as eleições
item.description: Justice Kássio Nunes Marques should lift his recusal for STF votes after the elections, including the session regarding investigation against Alexandre de Moraes. This decision allows him to participate in trials after the electoral period.

item.title: A materialização do absurdo
item.description: The text suggests that a crisis at the STF could lead to Flávio Bolsonaro's election, depicting it as a surreal absurdity. Institutional crisis and political polarization are presented as concerning factors.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro afirma que reajuste do Bolsa Família durante eleições é 'ilegal' e 'proibido'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) criticized the 15% Bolsa Família adjustment announced by Lula's government (PT), calling it illegal and prohibited for being done during elections. There are 17 days left before the first round of the presidential election.

item.title: Em 2024, STF considerou inconstitucional aumento de Bolsa Família em ano eleitoral
item.description: In August 2024, the STF partially annulled the constitutional amendment proposed by the Bolsonaro government that allowed increased social benefits such as Bolsa Família and Gas Assistance during an election year. The Court ruled that such measures disrupt the electoral period and violate constitutional principles.

item.title: Lula vai ao TSE contra Flávio após acusação de “dividir poder” com Moraes
item.description: Lula's coalition filed a lawsuit with the TSE against Flávio Bolsonaro, requesting a right of reply over statements accusing the president of sharing power with Minister Moraes. The campaign questions the veracity of the claims, deeming them misinformation about Brazil's constitutional framework. The case was assigned to Minister André Mendonça, with a preliminary injunction requested to suspend rebroadcasting the ad.

item.title: O tradutor infiel: o STF entre o espetáculo e a fulanização
item.description: The STF is portrayed as a 'faithless translator' favoring political interests and institutional mediation over legal certainty, undermining decisional consistency and turning proceedings into media performances via TV Justiça. The text highlights institutional flaws and key figures contributing to the court's reputational crisis.

item.title: Novo avalia recorrer contra decisão de Lula de reajustar Bolsa Família a 2 semanas do primeiro turno
item.description: The Novo party is evaluating legal action to challenge Lula's decision to adjust Bolsa Família 17 days before the first round, viewing it as an electorally motivated measure. The party sees weakness in the PT campaign, especially after Supreme Court criticisms and polls placing Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro segura facão falso e defende castração química de estupradores
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Presidential candidate, waved a fake knife at a rally in Recife and advocated chemical castration for rapists. The event is part of his electoral campaign in Northeast Brazil. The speech sparked reactions regarding public safety and human rights.

item.title: Pesquisa aponta que solidão e exaustão ampliam abstenção nas urnas
item.description: The Termômetro do Bem Viver survey reveals that loneliness, mental exhaustion and digital dependency are the main factors linked to voter abstention in Brazil, with 30 million voters choosing not to vote. Young people aged 18 to 34 represent 44% of the 'unconnected', individuals who rarely vote or have abandoned voting due to feeling isolated and powerless to change reality.

item.title: Em SC, Renan Santos diz que acionará o TSE contra aumento do Bolsa Família em período eleitoral
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from Missão to the Presidency, announced a lawsuit against the TSE over the 15% increase in Bolsa Família, criticizing Lula's government for considering the adjustment a 'vote buying'. During his campaign in Chapecó, he also proposed judicial reforms and emphasized support for agribusiness.

item.title: Veja ligações de ministros do STF com o caso Master
item.description: Investigations reveal connections between former banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, and five STF ministers, raising concerns about influence over the case handling in court. Messages and documents extracted by the Federal Police indicate personal and professional contacts between Vorcaro and the judges.

item.title: AGU validou reajuste do Bolsa Família em período eleitoral
item.description: The AGU validated the Bolsa Família adjustment based on INPC, stating there is no electoral restriction, as it is an inflationary correction without expanding beneficiaries. The family floor increased from R$ 600 to R$ 691. The decision was justified as an exercise of executive authority under law, outside the scope of the Electoral Law.

item.title: Trump exigiu eleições “livres” e proteção a “dissidentes” do Brasil
item.description: Confidential documents reveal that the Trump administration demanded Brazil not arrest or prevent political dissidents from participating in the 2026 elections, in addition to ensuring free and fair elections. The proposal was part of a 21-point commercial agreement and was rejected by Lula's government.

item.title: Moraes aparece em 72% dos posts sobre Master durante sessão do STF
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes was mentioned in 72.8% of publications about the Master case on September 15, 2026, during the STF's suspended hearing. DSC LAB analysis showed 12,952 mentions of the minister, with 55% critical tone, mainly due to suspected irregularities involving his wife's law firm. Minister André Mendonça was also heavily cited, with 7,652 publications.

item.title: Flávio não vai acionar TSE contra reajuste do Bolsa Família
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro decided not to sue the TSE against Lula's campaign over the Bolsa Família adjustment before the 2026 elections. According to O Antagonista, the senator's campaign strategy is to avoid judicialization and stay focused on the electoral race.

item.title: Crise no STF e queda em pesquisas determina ajustes em campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign will be adjusted in the final stretch due to declining polls and STF crisis, shifting toward more direct political confrontations and sharper criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro. The president will emphasize national sovereignty while reducing focus on legacy messaging to align with current electoral dynamics.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que não tem ajuda do governo Trump nas eleições: ‘Quem resolve é a gente aqui’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) denied receiving support from the Trump administration in the 2026 elections, stating the vote will be decided domestically. He criticized Brazil's diplomacy under Lula and pledged to restore international respect. Leaked documents show the U.S. demanded political dissidents' participation in the election following the 50% tariff.

item.title: A distância entre Lula e Bolsonaro no Datafolha a três semanas da eleição de 2022
item.description: Datafolha releases a new 2026 electoral poll showing Lula at 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 35% in the first round, with Augusto Cury in third place at 6%. Compared to 2022, the race is tighter, especially in the second round, where the two candidates are technically tied.

item.title: Wellington Dias nega relação entre reajuste do Bolsa Família e eleição
item.description: Minister Wellington Dias denied that the 15.04% raise in Bolsa Família is linked to the 2026 elections, stating it is part of Lula's social agenda. Announced 17 days before the first round, the measure sparked opposition criticism over its political timing.

item.title: Lula usa Bolsa Família como moeda eleitoral e dá xeque-mate em Flávio, que fica de mãos atadas
item.description: Lula announced a Bolsa Família adjustment two weeks before the first round, using it as electoral currency to weaken Flávio Bolsonaro, who leads in polling. The measure aims to neutralize the PL's appeal in the Northeast, where Lula has a strong electoral base and the majority of program beneficiaries.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos à Presidência da República do Brasil nas eleições 2026
item.description: Brazil's 2026 presidential elections will feature 13 officially registered candidates following the party conventions, including incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) seeking reelection and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) representing the Bolsonaro legacy. Jair Bolsonaro (PL) is ineligible due to imprisonment for attempting a coup d'état, and Pablo Marçal (PRTB) had his candidacy rejected by the TSE.

item.title: Reajuste de Lula ao Bolsa Família não é o maior já feito em ano eleitoral, apesar de tempo recorde
item.description: President Lula announced a 15% adjustment to Bolsa Família, to take effect in October, between the first and second electoral rounds. Despite the strategic timing, it is the smallest adjustment in an election year since 2014. The largest increase was made by Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, raising the Auxílio Brasil from R$ 400 to R$ 600 (50%).

item.title: Campanha de Lula na TV tenta colar em Flavio a pecha de 'mentiroso'
item.description: The PT's electoral broadcast on Thursday night aims to link Flávio Bolsonaro with the image of a liar, using a strategy already tested in digital campaigns. The approach is based on qualitative research showing voter distrust toward the senator. The petista campaign bets on credibility charges as a central point against the right-wing candidate.
